description: A lightweight web application for managing personal tasks with priority levels and due dates, allowing users to create, edit, complete, and organize their to‑do items efficiently.
target_users: Individuals seeking a minimalistic task manager
core_features: Set due dates and view upcoming tasks
Sort and filter tasks by priority and due date
future_features: Email reminders for upcoming due dates

milestones: Develop task CRUD endpoints with priority and due date fields
Build basic UI for task list and task form
Deploy initial version to a staging environment
Add task completion toggle in UI and API
Implement sorting and filtering by priority and due date
Improve responsive design and user experience
Add support for task categories and tags
Implement email reminder notifications for upcoming due dates
